notes: Novice-onboarding release: the console now teaches the relationship, not the feature list. A new Journey card on the Overview carries the L0–L4 adoption ladder — installed is already a win, and each level adds exactly one concept (brain, skills, pocket, full-open) with ONE next action — plus the five ritual moments we celebrate together (first bark, first response, first job, pocket dog, it remembers you), each computed from your own local state and never uploaded. The Extensions board is now yours to curate: the redundant fixed Home/Vehicle tabs are gone, categories appear only when you add them (eight max, any name — smart diet included), and Home/Vehicle/Smart-diet live on as inert preset examples that do nothing until you adopt them and add real sources on the SENSE board. The first-run welcome now names the no-key start out loud: watchdog mode needs no brain — watch a page or set a reminder, add a brain later. Console smoke grows to 477/477 and locale packs to 1335 keys per language.
